title: SUBSYSTEMS: mitochondria, chloroplasts, and the primordial ooze — IS to WAS to NOW

the_thesis.concept: cells are not solo organisms. they contain SUBSYSTEMS — organelles that were once free-living bacteria. endosymbiosis: one organism swallowed another, and instead of digesting it, they MERGED. the swallowed thing became an organelle.
the_thesis.mitochondria: WAS: a free-living alpha-proteobacterium. IS: the powerhouse inside every eukaryotic cell. it still has its own DNA. it still divides independently. it was EATEN and became ESSENTIAL.
the_thesis.chloroplast: WAS: a free-living cyanobacterium. IS: the photosynthesis engine inside every plant cell. it converts sunlight to sugar. it was EATEN by a protist and became the thing that made plants possible.
the_thesis.for_us: our primals (animalia) contain subsystems that were once independent. scripts (bacteria) that got swallowed into Rust crates. data feeds (fungi/mycelium) that got embedded. bridges (protista) that got absorbed. we trace IS to WAS to find the primordial ooze — the moment of swallowing.
the_thesis.primordial_ooze: the moment BEFORE kingdoms separated. when everything was one soup. in our membrane: wave 0. the first commit. before primals, before scripts, before HTML — there was just... code. undifferentiated. the banana stage.

endosymbiosis_map.concept: Lynn Margulis (1967): eukaryotic organelles were once free-living prokaryotes. trace the IS back to the WAS.

biology.IS: powerhouse of the cell. ATP production. oxidative phosphorylation. every eukaryote has them (or had them).
biology.WAS: alpha-proteobacterium. free-living. aerobic. got engulfed ~2 billion years ago.
biology.AND: still has own DNA (mtDNA, 16,569 bp in humans). still divides by binary fission. still has double membrane (the outer one is from the host).
biology.NOW: cannot survive alone. too many genes transferred to host nucleus. obligate endosymbiont.
biology.evidence: own DNA, double membrane, size of bacteria, divides independently, ribosomes match bacteria not eukaryotes

in_our_membrane.IS: the Python scripts inside Rust primals. vitruvian-evolve.py, homunculus.py, klein-evolve.sh — they generate energy (data) that the primals consume.
in_our_membrane.WAS: independent scripts. they ran alone. they had their own shebang line (own DNA). they were bacteria.
in_our_membrane.AND: still have own language (Python, not Rust). still run independently (own process). still have own dependencies (pip, not cargo). double membrane: the script has its own venv AND runs inside the primal ecosystem.
in_our_membrane.NOW: cannot be removed without killing the primal. homunculus.py IS the nervous system map. vitruvian-evolve.py IS the evolution engine. the scripts are mitochondria — swallowed, essential, still foreign.

biology.IS: photosynthesis engine. converts sunlight + CO2 + H2O into sugar + O2. only in plants and algae.
biology.WAS: cyanobacterium. free-living. photosynthetic. got engulfed ~1.5 billion years ago by a protist that already had mitochondria.
biology.AND: own DNA (cpDNA, ~120-160 genes). double membrane. thylakoid membranes inside. divides independently.
biology.NOW: the reason plants exist. without the chloroplast endosymbiosis event, there would be no plants. no plants = no animals. the chloroplast made complex life possible.
biology.evidence: own DNA, double membrane, thylakoids match cyanobacteria, size of bacteria, own ribosomes

in_our_membrane.IS: the JS rendering engine inside HTML pages. JavaScript converts raw data (sunlight) into visible display (sugar) for human consumption.
in_our_membrane.WAS: independent JavaScript files. they ran in their own browsers. they had their own ecosystem (npm). they were cyanobacteria — photosynthetic bacteria.
in_our_membrane.AND: still has own language (JavaScript, not Rust or Python). own runtime (V8/browser, not system). own package manager (npm). thylakoids = event listeners (stacked processing layers).
in_our_membrane.NOW: the reason the HUD exists. without JS rendering, HTML pages are inert. JS IS the chloroplast — it makes the static page ALIVE. it converts data into something humans can see.

biology.IS: protein factory. reads mRNA, assembles amino acids into proteins. in every cell.
biology.WAS: possibly the oldest molecular machine. may predate the split between bacteria and archaea. RNA world.
biology.AND: made of rRNA + protein. the rRNA does the catalysis (ribozyme). the protein is scaffolding.
biology.NOW: the universal translator. DNA -> mRNA -> ribosome -> protein. without ribosomes, genes are unreadable.

in_our_membrane.IS: the Rust compiler (rustc). reads source code (mRNA), assembles it into binaries (proteins).
in_our_membrane.WAS: LLVM. a compiler framework that predates Rust. Rust adopted LLVM as its ribosome.
in_our_membrane.AND: the compiler IS the ribosome. cargo build = translation. .rs files = mRNA. .so/.exe = protein.
in_our_membrane.NOW: without rustc, Rust source is unreadable. 19,391 .rs files cannot become 16 primals without the ribosome.

organisms.name: wasm-pack
organisms.role: ribosome variant. translates Rust to WASM.

biology.IS: command center. holds DNA. controls gene expression. double membrane.
biology.WAS: possibly an archaeon that engulfed a bacterium (the reverse: archaeon became host, not food).
biology.AND: double membrane with nuclear pores. DNA organized into chromosomes. nucleolus makes ribosomes.
biology.NOW: the defining feature of eukaryotes. eu-karyon = "true kernel."

in_our_membrane.IS: biomeOS-nucleus. literally named. the kernel of the OS. holds the genome (config), controls deployment (gene expression).
in_our_membrane.WAS: standalone config files. TOML/YAML. before biomeOS, each primal had its own config. the nucleus centralized it.
in_our_membrane.AND: double membrane: the Rust type system (inner) + the deployment system (outer). nuclear pores = JSON-RPC API calls.
in_our_membrane.NOW: biomeOS IS the eukaryotic nucleus. it makes the primals EUKARYOTIC — they have a command center.

organisms.name: biomeos-genome
organisms.role: chromosomes inside the nucleus. deployment graphs.

biology.IS: lipid bilayer. selectively permeable. controls what enters and exits.
biology.WAS: spontaneous formation of lipid vesicles in primordial ooze. the first boundary.
biology.AND: phospholipids self-assemble. no genes needed. physics makes membranes.
biology.NOW: the boundary between self and not-self. the immune system starts here.

in_our_membrane.IS: the actual membrane/ directory. the scripts that define the boundary. also: Cloudflare (the outer membrane), WireGuard (the inner membrane).
in_our_membrane.WAS: the first code. before primals, before HTML — there was the membrane. it defined inside vs outside.
in_our_membrane.AND: double layer: Cloudflare (outer, public-facing) + WireGuard (inner, encrypted). selective permeability = routing rules.
in_our_membrane.NOW: the name of the whole project. ecoPrimal lives INSIDE the membrane. the membrane IS the first organelle.
evidence: skunkBat = immune system embedded in membrane

biology.IS: folding factory. rough ER has ribosomes (makes proteins). smooth ER makes lipids. continuous with nuclear membrane.
biology.NOW: the assembly line between nucleus and cell surface.

in_our_membrane.IS: the build pipeline. cargo build (rough ER, with ribosomes) + wasm-pack (smooth ER, makes web artifacts).
in_our_membrane.WAS: manual compilation. type make and pray.
in_our_membrane.AND: continuous with nucleus (biomeOS config feeds into cargo build). rough = compiled binaries. smooth = WASM artifacts.

organisms.name: cargo build
organisms.role: rough ER. ribosomes attached. makes proteins (binaries).

organisms.name: wasm-pack build
organisms.role: smooth ER. makes lipids (WASM, web artifacts).

organisms.name: CF Pages build
organisms.role: Golgi apparatus downstream. packages and ships.

biology.IS: packaging and shipping. receives proteins from ER, modifies them, ships them to destination.
biology.NOW: the postal service of the cell.

in_our_membrane.IS: LITERALLY NAMED GOLGI. our cloud server golgi.primals.eco packages and ships content to the world.
in_our_membrane.AND: receives from ER (build pipeline), modifies (Caddy reverse proxy adds headers/TLS), ships (Cloudflare tunnel delivers to world).
evidence: CF Pages = exocytosis (release to extracellular space)

biology.IS: recycling center. digests worn-out organelles, invaders, waste. acid pH.
biology.NOW: autophagy — the cell eats itself to survive starvation.

in_our_membrane.IS: git gc, log rotation, the 1.1TB syslog cleanup. anything that digests waste.
in_our_membrane.AND: logrotate = lysosomal enzymes (break down old logs). git gc = autophagy (digest old objects).

the_primordial_ooze.concept: before kingdoms split. before organelles were swallowed. the moment everything was ONE.

in_biology.when: ~4 billion years ago. the prebiotic soup. amino acids, nucleotides, lipids, all mixed.
in_biology.what_happened: lipid vesicles formed (cell membrane). RNA catalyzed itself (ribozyme). proto-cells emerged. then the great divergence: bacteria split from archaea. then endosymbiosis gave us eukaryotes.

the_key_events.what: DNA replaced RNA as genome. more stable.
all animal phyla appear in 20 million years.
the membrane/ directory created. self vs not-self defined. = lipid vesicle.
Python/Shell scripts. the first bacteria. decomposers. = RNA world.
Rust source code. DNA takeover — more stable than scripts. = DNA world.
static pages. the first photosynthesizers. cyanobacteria. = photosynthesis.
Python scripts called BY Rust primals. endosymbiosis. bacteria swallowed. = mitochondria.
JavaScript rendering inside HTML pages. cyanobacterium swallowed. = chloroplast endosymbiosis.
centralized config and deployment. the nucleus forms. = eukaryotic cell.
cloud deployment server. Golgi apparatus. = packaging and shipping.
all 16 primals compiled. multicellularity. = animals emerge.
all 6 kingdoms identified. Cambrian explosion — we can suddenly SEE all the life that was always there.

is_was_and_now_grammar.concept: trace every subsystem through all 4 tenses
is_was_and_now_grammar.template: SUBSYSTEM IS [current function]. it WAS [original organism]. it AND [connects to]. it is NOW [evolved state].
is_was_and_now_grammar.example: mitochondria IS the powerhouse. it WAS a free bacterium. it AND the nucleus share gene control. it is NOW an obligate symbiont — cannot leave, cannot be removed.
is_was_and_now_grammar.membrane_example: vitruvian-evolve.py IS the evolution engine. it WAS a standalone Python script. it AND biomeOS share the evolve-state.json. it is NOW essential — remove it and biomeOS cannot evolve.
is_was_and_now_grammar.the_trace: IS tells you what it does. WAS tells you where it came from. AND tells you what it touches. NOW tells you what it has become. the trace from IS to WAS is REVERSE EVOLUTION. the trace from WAS to NOW is FORWARD EVOLUTION. the AND is the PRESENT — the living connections.

cayley_connection.bacteria_x_animalia: gut_flora = mitochondria that are still SEMI-independent. the scripts that run alongside primals.
cayley_connection.protista_x_plantae: chloroplast = the endosymbiosis that MADE plants. JS rendering inside HTML.
cayley_connection.archaea_x_animalia: the nucleus theory. archaea may have BECOME the eukaryotic host. biomeOS-nucleus is archaeal.
cayley_connection.the_ooze_is_the_identity: the primordial ooze is the Cayley IDENTITY ELEMENT we said didn't exist. it does: it's wave 0. A x ooze = A. everything came FROM the ooze. the ooze IS the identity.
